candidate_evidence.quote: [DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT] Salovum (other names: Antisecretory factor): Ingestion of Salovum 11g three times daily during 48 hours
Since Salovum® is not classified as a drug, clinical trials have only required ethics approval.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To measure inflammatory cytokine release by sampling of extracellular fluid with a microdialysis probe (Dialysis, Sweden) and analysis by multiplex arrays (Mesoscale Discovery, US)
Intratumoral pressure after ingestion of Salovum®

role_evidence.quote: Salovum®, an egg yolk powder enriched with the endogenous protein antisecretory factor

agents.drug_class_hint: egg yolk powder enriched with antisecretory factor; food for special medical purposes / dietary supplement

coder_notes: Salovum is registered as a dietary supplement and described as a food for special medical purposes, not a drug, so it is treated as a supplement (excluded intervention type). Primary outcome is intratumoral pressure, not tumour-drug concentration, so tumour_pk_planned is no. Patients have suspected glioblastoma at diagnostic biopsy.
